# Adopting

A host builds a `threetears.evals.host.EvalHost` and reads leases from `threetears.evals.shapes`.

```python
from threetears.evals.ops import OpsHost, runs_list

runs_list(OpsHost())
```

```text
threetears.evals.host.OpsHost stays a spelling in a text fence; prose token mode rewrites it.
```
